constraints.name: order_items_order_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

fuel_logs.name: fuel_logs
fuel_logs.comment: Registro detallado de consumo de combustible por unidad y conductor.

delivery_outbox.name: delivery_outbox
delivery_outbox.comment: Eventos de entrega escritos en la misma transacción que la prueba y publicados con reintento.

columns.name: customer_accepted
columns.comment: Declaración del operador sobre la aceptación del cliente; no es firma certificada del cliente.

columns.name: retry_order_id
columns.comment: New linked attempt. Original terminal order and POD are never rewritten.

constraints.name: ck_incident_resolution
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'OPEN'::text) AND (resolved_at IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = 'RESOLVED'::text) AND ((outcome)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['RETRY'::character varying, 'REPLAN'::character varying, 'CLOSE_FAILED'::character varying, 'CLOSE_CASE'::character varying])::text[])) AND (resolution_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (resolved_by IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: ck_improvement_status
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['OPEN'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying, 'VERIFIED'::character varying, 'DISCARDED'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: ck_improvement_verification
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status)::text <> 'VERIFIED'::text) OR ((result_value IS NOT NULL) AND (verified_by IS NOT NULL) AND (note IS NOT NULL))))

order_attempts.name: order_attempts
order_attempts.comment: Un reintento crea un pedido nuevo vinculado; nunca modifica el resultado histórico original.

constraints.name: analytics_goals_code_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((code)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['IID'::character varying, 'CHR'::character varying, 'TDE'::character varying, 'SUCCESS'::character varying, 'ONTIME'::character varying])::text[])))

analytics_goal_history.name: analytics_goal_history
analytics_goal_history.comment: Historial de metas efectivas, actor autenticado y fecha. Sin metas precargadas.

analytics_order_facts.name: analytics_order_facts
analytics_order_facts.comment: RF81: datos verificables de pedido, operación Lima, RUC P01, evidencia digital y metadatos de integridad. No verifica objetos remotos.

analytics_route_facts.name: analytics_route_facts
analytics_route_facts.comment: Distancia GPS Haversine dentro de la ruta; mínimo 2 muestras. Minutos de operación por parada terminal DELIVERED/FAILED/RETURNED, no tiempo de servicio.

excluded.local_evidence_backups: soporte técnico de evidencia local; fuera del ERD de negocio

foreignKeys.name: order_items_order_id_fkey
foreignKeys.definition: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

limits: No se infieren FK por nombres de columnas ni dependencias de vistas.
No se exportaron índices; UQ sólo identifica constraints UNIQUE del JSON.
Nulabilidad de vistas es la del catálogo, no garantía sobre sus tablas fuente.
Keycloak es externo, no tabla local; conexión discontinua es lógica.
Respaldo local de evidencia excluido del negocio; volumen LocalStack no demuestra durabilidad.
